test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Data Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records data at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
System is powered on and operational.

test_steps.action: Observe the EMS interface for a designated GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays real-time temperature readings for the selected storage area.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the EMS interface showing real-time temperature.

test_steps.action: Monitor the recorded data log for the same storage area over a period of at least 10 minutes.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are logged at intervals of 5 minutes or less.
data_to_capture: Exported data log showing timestamps and temperature readings.
Analysis of timestamps to confirm recording interval.

acceptance_criteria: The system continuously displays real-time temperature readings.
All recorded temperature data points are within 5 minutes of each other.
data_integrity_requirements: Data is recorded accurately and without loss.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Deviation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS operates within the specified temperature range and accuracy, and generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all GMP storage areas.
System is powered on and operational.
A specific GMP storage area is selected for testing.
A setpoint for temperature monitoring is defined for the selected area.

test_steps.action: Using a calibrated external temperature source, simulate a temperature reading within the specified range (-80°C to +50°C) in the selected GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays a temperature reading that is within ±0.5°C of the simulated temperature.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the EMS interface showing the recorded temperature.
Reading from the calibrated external temperature source.

test_steps.action: Adjust the simulated temperature to be 2°C above the defined setpoint for the selected storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification indicating a temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the EMS alert notification.

test_steps.action: Adjust the simulated temperature to be 2°C below the defined setpoint for the selected storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification indicating a temperature deviation.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the EMS alert notification.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS accurately reflects the simulated temperature within ±0.5°C.
An alert is generated when the temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint (both high and low).
Alerts are clearly visible and identifiable within the system.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature readings are accurate and reliable.
Alarm triggers are correctly recorded and associated with the correct temperature deviations.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Unmodified and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the vendor-supplied software is used without modification and that data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and operational.
Access to system configuration and database logs.

test_steps.action: Review system installation files and configuration settings to confirm no modifications have been made to the vendor-supplied software.
test_steps.expected_result: No unauthorized modifications to the vendor-supplied software are identified.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS database and examine the format of stored temperature and humidity data.
test_steps.expected_result: Stored data is in the vendor's standard database format, as documented by the vendor.

acceptance_criteria: The vendor-supplied software is confirmed to be unmodified.
The format of stored data aligns with the vendor's standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data stored in a verifiable and standard format.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification Integration and Response Time
test_cases.objective: To verify that alarm notifications integrate with the site paging system using the vendor API and that system response time for alarm conditions meets the specified requirement.
prerequisites: EMS system is operational and configured for alarm notifications.
Site paging system is operational and accessible.
Vendor API documentation for alarm notifications is available.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition (e.g., by temporarily altering a sensor reading or simulating a fault).
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm is generated within the EMS.

test_steps.action: Observe the site paging system to confirm receipt of the alarm notification.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is received by the designated personnel via the site paging system.

test_steps.action: Measure the time elapsed from alarm generation in the EMS to the receipt of the notification on the paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: The system response time for alarm conditions does not exceed 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications are successfully integrated with the site paging system.
The system response time for alarm conditions is within the 30-second limit.
data_integrity_requirements: Timely and accurate notification of critical environmental deviations.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system maintains a comprehensive audit trail and supports electronic signatures as per 21 CFR Part 11.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
Access to system logs and audit trail reports.

test_steps.action: Perform a critical system action, such as changing a setpoint or acknowledging an alarm, using a user account.
test_steps.expected_result: The system logs the action in the audit trail, including user ID, date, time, action performed, and any affected parameters.
data_to_capture: Audit trail log entry for the performed action.

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify or delete an existing audit trail entry.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prevents modification or deletion of audit trail entries.
data_to_capture: Error message or system behavior indicating prevention of modification/deletion.

test_steps.action: Perform an action requiring an electronic signature (e.g., approving a report or a configuration change).
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for and captures a valid electronic signature, including user ID, date, time, and reason for signature.
data_to_capture: Electronic signature record associated with the action.

test_steps.action: Review the generated audit trail report and electronic signature records.
test_steps.expected_result: All recorded actions and signatures are accurate, complete, and comply with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
data_to_capture: Screenshots or exported reports of audit trail and electronic signatures.

acceptance_criteria: All actions performed are logged in the audit trail with complete and accurate information.
Audit trail entries are immutable and cannot be altered or deleted.
Electronic signatures are captured correctly with all required components.
Audit trail and electronic signature records meet the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be complete, consistent, and accurate.
Electronic signatures must be unique, attributable, and non-repudiable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Data Archival and Retention Capabilities
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS system can archive historical data and retain it for the required 7-year period.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data has been generated to test archival.
Access to system archival and retrieval functions.
Understanding of the vendor's archival process.

test_steps.action: Initiate the data archival process for a defined period of historical data (e.g., 1 year).
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives the specified historical data, and the original data is no longer readily accessible in the active database.

test_steps.action: Attempt to retrieve archived data from the archival storage.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully retrieves the archived data, and it is presented in a readable format.

test_steps.action: Verify that the retrieved archived data matches the original data that was archived.
test_steps.expected_result: The retrieved data is identical to the original data, ensuring data integrity during archival and retrieval.
data_to_capture: Comparison report or evidence of data matching.

test_steps.action: Simulate the passage of time to ensure the system's archival mechanism supports the 7-year retention requirement.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's archival feature is designed to manage data retention for at least 7 years, and no data is prematurely purged.
data_to_capture: Documentation or configuration settings related to data retention policies.

acceptance_criteria: Data archival process completes successfully.
Archived data can be reliably retrieved.
Retrieved archived data maintains its integrity and matches the original data.
The system's archival and retention features support the required 7-year data retention period.
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must be complete, accurate, and uncorrupted.
Data retrieval must be efficient and reliable.
Data retention policies must be enforced.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Usage for Batch Release
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system's standard reports are utilized for batch release as per URS-EMS-007.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to generate reports.
Access to EMS reporting module.

test_steps.action: Access the reporting module of the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: The reporting module is accessible and displays available report templates.
data_to_capture: Screenshot of the reporting module interface.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard report for a specific period (e.g., a batch production period).
test_steps.expected_result: A report is generated successfully in the vendor's standard format, containing relevant temperature and humidity data.

test_steps.action: Review the generated report to confirm it contains all required data points for batch release (e.g., temperature, humidity, timestamps, alarm events).
test_steps.expected_result: The report accurately reflects the monitored environmental conditions and is suitable for use in batch release decisions.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of data accuracy in the report.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS generates standard reports as defined by the vendor.
The generated reports contain all necessary data for batch release.
The reports are in the vendor's standard format.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-007: Standard reports provided by vendor shall be used for batch release.
data_integrity_requirements: Data in reports must be accurate and complete.
Reports must be generated in a verifiable format.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS meets the specified system availability and data storage capacity requirements.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
System has been running for a significant period to assess availability.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 1 month) and record any unplanned downtime.
test_steps.expected_result: The total unplanned downtime is less than 0.5% of the monitoring period, meeting URS-EMS-013.
data_to_capture: Record of all unplanned downtime events (start/end times, duration, cause).

test_steps.action: Query the EMS database or system logs to determine the current data storage utilization.
test_steps.expected_result: The current data storage utilization is significantly less than the capacity required to support 10 years of continuous monitoring, meeting URS-EMS-012.
data_to_capture: Current data storage usage (e.g., GB used).
System configuration details regarding storage allocation.

test_steps.action: Calculate the projected data storage needs for 10 years based on current data generation rates.
test_steps.expected_result: The projected storage need for 10 years is within the system's designed capacity.

acceptance_criteria: System availability is 99.5% or higher, excluding planned maintenance.
Data storage capacity supports a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
regulatory_basis: URS-EMS-011: System response time shall not exceed 30 seconds for alarm conditions.
URS-EMS-012: Data storage capacity shall support minimum 10 years of continuous monitoring.
URS-EMS-013: System availability shall be 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
data_integrity_requirements: Continuous data availability is critical for environmental monitoring.
Sufficient storage ensures data is not lost due to capacity limits.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Facility Management System Integration via Standard Protocols
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System can successfully interface with the existing facility management system using standard communication protocols.
prerequisites: Facility management system is operational and accessible.
Network connectivity between EMS and facility management system is established.
Appropriate credentials for accessing both systems are available.

test_steps.action: Configure the EMS to establish a connection with the facility management system using the specified standard protocols (e.g., Modbus, BACnet).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS successfully establishes a connection with the facility management system, indicated by a status message or log entry.

test_steps.action: Initiate data transfer from the EMS to the facility management system for a selected set of environmental parameters (e.g., temperature from one sensor).
test_steps.expected_result: The facility management system receives and displays the transmitted environmental data accurately and within the expected timeframe.
data_to_capture: Environmental data values as displayed in the facility management system
Log entries from both systems indicating successful data transfer

test_steps.action: Induce a minor deviation in a monitored parameter (e.g., slightly increase temperature in a test area) and observe if this change is reflected in the facility management system.
test_steps.expected_result: The facility management system updates to reflect the induced environmental parameter change within the defined integration latency.
data_to_capture: Observed environmental parameter change in EMS
Reflected environmental parameter change in facility management system

acceptance_criteria: The EMS successfully establishes and maintains a connection with the facility management system.
Environmental data is accurately transmitted and displayed in the facility management system.
Changes in environmental parameters are reflected in the facility management system within acceptable latency.
data_integrity_requirements: Data transmitted must be accurate and complete.
Data transfer should be reliable and without corruption.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System meets the specified availability target and has sufficient data storage capacity for the required retention period.
prerequisites: System has been operational for a sufficient period to assess availability.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools for availability tracking.
Knowledge of the system's data storage configuration and capacity.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime and downtime over a defined period (e.g., 30 days) excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
test_steps.expected_result: The calculated system availability percentage is greater than or equal to 99.5%.

test_steps.action: Review system logs and storage utilization reports to estimate the current data storage consumption rate.
test_steps.expected_result: The current data storage consumption rate, extrapolated over 10 years, does not exceed the allocated storage capacity.
data_to_capture: Estimated remaining storage capacity based on current rate

test_steps.action: Simulate continuous monitoring for a period equivalent to the data storage capacity requirement (e.g., 10 years) or review vendor documentation on storage projections.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully stores data for the simulated period without errors or capacity limitations.
data_to_capture: Confirmation of no storage-related errors during simulation
Vendor documentation on storage capacity and longevity

acceptance_criteria: The system availability is at least 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
The system's data storage capacity is sufficient to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.
No data loss or corruption occurs due to storage limitations.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be continuously available for monitoring and reporting.
Data must be stored without loss or corruption for the entire retention period.
